create_dictionary: create a Dictionary instance with pad, eos, unk, and bos special symbols for token-to-index mapping
load_dictionary_from_file: load a pre-built Dictionary from a text file using Dictionary.load with symbol and count pairs
encode_line_to_ids: encode a text line into a tensor of token indices using Dictionary.encode_line with optional eos append
convert_tensor_to_string: convert a tensor of token indices back to a human-readable string using Dictionary.string with BPE post-processing
add_file_to_dictionary: build a Dictionary from a text file by tokenizing lines and counting word frequencies with multiprocessing support
